thread:
Marta L: locking a 2h change window for BlueRidge Medical dedicated rollout. Proposed: 2024-04-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Can everyone ack by EOD?

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout request received for tenant blueridge-med. tentative window 2024-04-12T02:00Z -> 2024-04-12T04:00Z. Canary slice: 5% traffic. Canary timeout: 15m.

Sam K: ack. Ops checklist: confirm model pin (rn: rdx-v2.1.4-quant), autoscale buffer 30%, and KV cache warm-up script.

Jia W: noted on model pin. We should pin to rdx-v2.1.4-quant-cpu-fallback for fallback path. Also set rollback threshold: p95 latency increase > 30% OR error-rate > 1.5% over 10m.

Marta L: agree on thresholds. Add a manual kill switch for customer slice.

Emily R: I'll own release notes and communication. Drafts at https://confluence.redwood.ai/blueridge-rollout. Will post customer-facing note 24h before.

Kevin O: oncall for the window. My pager is set. If canary fails, plan: rollback-canary -> pin previous model -> redeploy. ETA for rollback < 10m. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: preflight checks OK: infra capacity verified (dedicated pool: 8xA100), KMS key access OK, network policies validated. Next step: finalize canary config.

Jia W: canary config snippet:
```
canary: {
  traffic_percent: 5,
  duration: 15m,
  metrics: ["p95_latency_ms","error_rate"]
}
rollback_policy: {
  p95_increase_pct: 30,
  error_rate_pct: 1.5
}
```

Sam K: KV cache warm-up command (run on edge nodes):
```
./kv-warmup --tenant blueridge --keys 20000 --parallel 8
```
I'll run this 1h before window.

Marta L: request: pin DB migration flag off. BlueRidge is on private deploy, no schema changes.

Emily R: release notes published and linked in customer slack. Confirmed with AE.

Kevin O: ack from me. +1 to go. Oncall playbook: https://playbooks.redwood.ai/blueridge-oncall

Marta L: marking thread ready. Last call for objections.

deploy-bot: rollout approved by required approvers (Marta L, Sam K, Kevin O). Scheduling finalization in 10m.

Sam K: quick note — keep quantization logs enabled in case we need postmortem.

Marta L: thanks team. I'll update the runbook and ping infra 30m before start. :rocket:
